_: walking_dead_remastered_le on 'The Walking Dead LE Premium (Stern 2014)' (VPUniverse
file 25269, by Clapper and others): the 2014 SAM playfield (ROM twd_160h) that Stern's
The Walking Dead Remastered (Spike 3) reuses. patch_walking_dead.py applies it to the
script; the controller reads switch_rewrite, solenoids and raw_lamp_rewrite (PAD-1560).
title: walking_dead_remastered_le

crossbow_encoder._: the Remastered crossbow motor counts encoder edges: the table's crossbow sweep (Darryl_Timer) steps these two switches in quadrature

_: Remastered coil [node, index] -> the SMALL number the table script sees it as: the SAM
solenoid number its SolCallback already uses, except the flippers, which take core.vbs's
Consts (sLRFlipper 46, sLLFlipper 48). The prison doors are one coil on the Remastered
game, held while open: it is both SAM 3 (power, opens) and 4 (hold, closes on release).
Coil group g is node g + 1 (TROUGH is group 7 index 1 = node 8, the run's ball model's).
`dof`: the number DOF knows a coil by (the ROM's), where the key is not it.

_led_lamps: no 1000 + node * 100 + index numbers: the table's LampTimer indexes its 220-long lamp arrays with every ChangedLamps number

_: SAM lamp number -> the Remastered LED(s) it reads as 0..255 (the brightest of
several: a one-colour SAM insert on an RGB insert lights in any colour). The table's
own LampTimer draws them. Fitted by place (lamp_notes); 211-218 are this map's own

flash_subs._: this map's lamp number -> the table's SolModCallback flasher sub, called with the LED's level 0..1 from its LampTimer (a flasher is an LED on the Remastered game)
